description: A NOTAM's own card, read from its parts (FAA Order JO 7930.2): its accountability (4-2-1, "FDC"); its category, a procedure NOTAM's by what the procedures are for (SID, ODP and DVA departures, STAR arrivals, IAP approaches; 1-2-1), the rest its heading; its title, what happened ("Runway 18/36 closed"): notam_read's what, else a surface its words close (RWY, TWY; 3-3-5, 3-3-6; CLSD, JO 7340.2), else the procedures not authorized (NA); one plain sentence of its effect ("Runway 18/36 is permanently closed, so its RNAV departures are not authorized."); whether the condition is permanent (PERM, 4-2-1, or its words' PERMANENTLY); and the procedures it takes away, each by its charted name and number (7-1-3: "ADELL EIGHT DEPARTURE (RNAV)" is "ADELL 8", RNAV). Each null or empty where the NOTAM's parts do not say all of it: the card then says its words written out (notam_read), never a guess.

text.description: The NOTAM as sent, domestic or ICAO form.

idents.description: The field's idents (OSH, KOSH), kept as written.

account.description: The domestic form's accountability ("FDC", "OSH"); null in the ICAO form.

category.description: What kind of thing it is about, a small label: "Departure procedures", "Arrival procedures", "Instrument approaches", else notam_read's heading (Runway, Taxiway, Navaid, Airspace ...).

title.description: What happened, the card's title: "Runway 18/36 closed"; null where its parts do not say it.

effect.description: One plain sentence of what it means: "Runway 18/36 is permanently closed, so its RNAV departures are not authorized."; null where its parts do not say it.

permanent.description: The condition is permanent: PERM as its end, or PERMANENTLY in its words (it stays until the charts show it).

procedures.description: The procedures it takes away (NA), in its order; empty where it takes none.

rnav.description: An RNAV procedure, "(RNAV)" on its title.

departure.description: A departure procedure (SID, ODP; DEPARTURE in its title, 7-1-3), which a field's departures use; false for an arrival (STAR), which its arrivals use.
